text_blocks.snippet: The average inflation rate in the US from 2016 to 2024 is approximately 3.30% per year. This means that prices, on average, have increased by about 33.94% over this period. In other words, $1 in 2016 has the same purchasing power as $1.34 today.

list.snippet: Year-over-year inflation: The annual inflation rate fluctuated throughout the period. In 2016, it was 1.26%, and by 2024, it was 2.35%.
Cumulative effect: The cumulative price increase from 2016 to 2025 is 33.94%, meaning prices are now 1.34 times higher than in 2016.
Buying power: A dollar in 2016 has roughly 74.627% of the buying power it had back then.
